operations.title: The first nonautomatic theta Weyl obstruction is a two-height Pick determinant
operations.statement: Positive theta density makes every one-point Pick test for M_Xi=-Xi'/Xi on the positive imaginary axis automatic. At two heights y1,y2 the first coupled condition is a1 a2/(y1 y2)-(a1+a2)^2/(y1+y2)^2 >=0, where a=B'/B and B is the theta cosh transform. It is source-only and any negative pair falsifies the Nevanlinna boundary; all finite Pick matrices are equivalent to the full RH positivity gate.
operations.scope: Exact positivity hierarchy and finite falsifier; no global two-height or full Pick positivity proof.

operations.title: Two-height theta Pick determinant hostile test
operations.description: Form the 2x2 Pick matrix at distinct imaginary heights from positive theta moments and evaluate its determinant without zero data.
